description: This file defines a PHP class 'AttendanceSummaryReportController' in the OrangeHRM HRM system. The class extends an abstract Vue controller, manages a component for attendance summary reports, and fetches company structure subunit data to pass to the view.

classes.name: AttendanceSummaryReportController
classes.description: Controller managing the attendance summary report view, extending AbstractVueController, and injecting company subunit data into the Vue component.

methods.name: getCompanyStructureService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of CompanyStructureService used to fetch company structure data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with the attendance report identifier and subunit data before rendering.
